title: Text model aliases take new routes
summary:
A routing-and-errors day: two text model aliases changed destinations, API errors got clearer, and image requests gained a token fallback.

`openai-large` now maps to `gpt-4o-mini` instead of `gpt-4o`, while `openai-reasoning` maps to `o1-mini` instead of `o3-mini`.

Errors now include upstream HTTP status and parsed details when available. Streaming content-filter failures return a simpler message and a `content_policy` flag.

When no token is supplied, image token extraction now checks the `Referer` or `Referrer` header.
